Title: odf-kit has HTML injection leading to XSS in odsToHtml() via unescaped style attribute values
Description: ODF style values are interpolated into `style="..."` attributes without HTML-escaping in odf-kit's ODS to-HTML renderer (`odsToHtml()`). A double-quote character inside an attacker-controlled style value breaks out of the attribute, allowing arbitrary HTML/attribute injection — and therefore script execution (XSS) — from a crafted `.ods` file wherever the rendered output is inserted as HTML, which is the documented purpose of the function.
NotImpacted: All versions before 0.9.8, all versions starting from 0.14.2
